messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT (P1) — Elevated 5xx rate for Cerulean enterprise dedicated cluster (eu-west-1). Error rate ~18% for ingestion/generation endpoints. Paging on-call. :rotating_light:
ryan: taking it — oncall here. ETA 5m for initial triage.
suresh: joining, pulling logs. I see a surge of OOMs and pods in CrashLoopBackOff around the autoscaler window.
ryan: noted. Katie, do we have Cerulean primary contacts listed? Need to inform account team ASAP.
katie: yes — pulling contact routing now. Primary AM: Priya Rao <priya@cerulean.com>, escalation: Daniel Zhou (CTO) +1-415-555-0199, security contact: sec@cerulean.com. Sending AC-level notify draft in a sec.
maria: drafting status page + tailored customer impact statement. Proposed short blurb below — plz ack/reword:
```
Summary: We are experiencing elevated 5xx errors for Cerulean's dedicated inference cluster in eu-west-1, impacting request success and increasing latency.
Impact: Intermittent failures for model inference and embeddings between 2024-06-14 12:15 UTC and ongoing. Cerulean customers may see 500 responses and delayed responses.
Mitigation: On-call team is investigating autoscaler/pod stability and applying temporary capacity increase; no data loss expected.
Next update: in 15 minutes or when we have a customer-facing mitigation.
```
suresh: ack. Running scaledown check and will attempt a rolling restart of the affected node pool. Command: 
```
kubectl get pods -n redwood-cerulean -o wide | grep CrashLoopBackOff
kubectl rollout restart deploy/cerulean-inference --namespace=redwood-cerulean
```
ryan: please run restart on blue pool only then monitor. If >20% error persists after restart, we'll trigger reserved-capacity fallback to the dedicated spare pool.
katie: sending tailored email to Priya + Daniel now (subject: Cerulean: Active incident affecting inference). Copy of message: "We're investigating elevated 5xx errors affecting your dedicated cluster in eu-west-1. Our engineers are actively mitigating; we'll follow up with targeted updates and timeline. If you have immediate questions call +1-415-555-0199."
statuspage-bot: Status page update published (Cerulean dedicated cluster — partial outage). URL: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/CRL-20240614-01
ops-scribe: noted for post-incident worksheet — capture autoscaler config, node metrics, and timeline. Assigning follow-ups: sres:autoscale-review, eng:pod-restart-review, cs:customer-communication-log.
ryan: mitigation in progress. Will report back with: 1) result of rolling restart, 2) temporary capacity change, 3) customer notification time.
maria: thanks — once we confirm mitigation I'll update the customer-facing timeline and include the tailored impact statement approved by Katie.
incident-bot: ALERT cleared? No — error rate down to 6% after restart but still above threshold. Continue monitoring.
ryan: update at +18m — errors dropped to 2.1%, rolling restart looks successful, no further paging. Planning a targeted follow-up to Cerulean with timeline and RCA ETA (by EOD).
ops-scribe: adding notes to this thread for the postmortem.
statuspage-bot: Updated: "Service degradation mitigated; additional monitoring in place. Root cause under investigation; next update by EOD."
